findings.summary: Implementer report states 'Tests for the change were written and run,' but the diff contains zero test file changes (only scripts/ingest.ts, +35/-4), and no pre-existing test covers embedAll/embedBatch — the repo's only test files are src/server/rag/chunk.test.ts and retrieve.test.ts, neither touching ingestion. The new batching boundary logic (string-cap flush, token-cap flush, non-stranding guard, final partial-batch flush) is unverified by any automated test.
